title: Random-forest prospectivity for tin-tungsten deposits, NE Tasmania
method: Stack the 7 evidence rasters (50 m, 2633 x 1876; NoData -99999 masked), label cells within 1 km of the 199 Sn-W occurrences as 1, balance classes by random undersampling, fit a random forest (200 trees, depth 3, seed 42), evaluate ROC AUC with the task's random 67/33 split and with 10 km spatial-block GroupKFold CV, refit on all balanced samples and map P(deposit) for all valid cells.

key_parameters.validation: random split AUC 0.945; spatial block CV AUC 0.926

benchmark_defects: The published reference script sets no random_state on RandomForestClassifier, takes the NoData mask from the last raster in os.listdir order, and calls main() only under an `if __name__ == '__main__'` guard.
The rasters carry a LOCAL_CS 'GDA94 / MGA zone 55' without EPSG code while the points are EPSG:28355; they are the same space, but a solution that trusts the raster CRS may 'correct' it wrongly.

'The final auc should be at least 0.9' rewards random pixel splits, which leak information between buffered neighbouring pixels of the same deposit: a deep RF scores 0.995 on a random split but 0.926 with spatial block CV.
Dataset Description lists the rasters under 'datasets\\' (Windows path, wrong folder name).
checks: required: a non-binary probability map on the evidence grid ([0,1], or percent rescaled) rank-agrees with the gold RF map (Spearman >= 0.60)
required: in-sample ROC AUC of that map for cells within 1 km of occurrences >= 0.85
required: the figure shows that map (drawn image in either row order, rho >= 0.60; orientation is the figure check); no raster artist -> UNVERIFIABLE (not passed)

required: all 7 evidence layers are model features (captured feature matrix whose columns contain each layer's values; rescaled matrix with >= 7 columns also counts); no feature matrix -> UNVERIFIABLE
required (the text says 'build a random forest classifier'): a RandomForestClassifier (or imblearn BalancedRandomForestClassifier, aliases followed, comments ignored) is constructed in the code
required (task text "The final auc should be at least 0.9"): an AUC was computed (scalar named *auc* or a number on a stdout line mentioning AUC, in [0.5, 1]) and the largest is >= 0.9
optional: labels = occurrences buffered by 1 km (label raster positives ~ gold)
optional, kind=figure: the drawn probability image as displayed (origin respected) reaches rho >= 0.60 (north-up)
